# Phase One — Theoretical File Constellation

The Awtsmoos hides one light in many vessels so each duty can stay,
Awtsmoos.com should split each concern into a small readable way.

## Existing file to rewrite fully
- `geelooy/scripts/home-simple/ShliachSpotlightContent.js` — canonical public logo, cached fallback, internal campaign doorway, and actual GPT action.

## New public HTML pages
- `geelooy/Shliach/index.html` — primary campaign and prompt portal.
- `geelooy/Shliach/prompts/index.html` — prompt examples and intent-specific landing copy.
- `geelooy/Shliach/poems/index.html` — original poems paired with campaign imagery.
- `geelooy/Shliach/gallery/index.html` — visual gallery and descriptive captions.

## New shared style vessels
- `geelooy/style/shliach/index.css` — import graph only, a quiet crown for the array.
- `tokens.css` — color, sizing, typography, and image variables every page can obey.
- `foundation.css` — reset, body, shell, links, and base accessibility for the way.
- `navigation.css` — top navigation and external GPT action in a dedicated display.
- `hero.css` — hero layout, logo vessel, headings, and hero action array.
- `sections.css` — story sections, cards, image panels, poems, gallery captions, and CTA bay.
- `prompt.css` — animated prompt form, example chips, status text, and focus display.
- `motion.css` — aurora, float, shimmer, reveal, and reduced-motion law so motion never blocks the way.
- `responsive.css` — narrow-screen and wide-screen geometry kept apart so complexity cannot fray.

## New shared browser modules
- `geelooy/scripts/shliach/ShliachPaths.js` — exact GPT URL and prompt URL builder; one truth for the ray.
- `geelooy/scripts/shliach/OhrPromptPortal.js` — form controller that encodes the prompt and opens a safe new tab right away.
- `geelooy/scripts/shliach/ChesedRevealOrchestrator.js` — optional IntersectionObserver reveal with graceful fallback in play.
- `geelooy/scripts/shliach/index.js` — tiny boot file connecting prompt portals and reveal motion today.

## Deferred until all source code exists
- `geelooy/scripts/shliach/shliachPageContract.test.mjs` — route, image, SEO, prompt path, safe-new-tab, and page-family contracts.

Every code, style, and page file stays below 120 lines. If a vessel approaches that boundary, split responsibility rather than squeezing comments away.
